name: What is AEO and how does it benefit construction companies?

mainEntity.name: What is AEO and how does it benefit construction companies?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO, or AI-Enhanced Optimization, leverages artificial intelligence to improve online visibility for construction companies. It analyzes vast amounts of data, including search trends, competitor strategies, and website performance, to identify optimal keywords, content gaps, and technical SEO improvements. This results in higher search engine rankings, increased organic traffic, and ultimately, more qualified leads and project inquiries for construction businesses.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO uses AI to boost a construction company's online visibility, leading to higher search rankings, more traffic, and increased leads.
